segments.name: Germany
segments.description: Provides mobile, broadband, TV and business digital services to consumer and business customers in Germany.
segments.evidence: We continue to be the largest provider of fixed line gigabit connectivity in Germany, as we market gigabit speeds to almost 75% of German homes with 5 million fibre households beyond our own cable footprint of 25 million households.

segments.name: UK
segments.description: Provides mobile and fixed connectivity services in the UK following the merger with Three UK.
segments.evidence: Following the merger of Vodafone UK with Three UK during the year, information is not yet available for Three UK employees.
